text: Fourteen months. Not because of my code. I was getting better.
I came back. Rewrote my résumé nine times. Heard nothing.
Honestly? The gap was in my head.
So I stopped. And treated it like a project.
I looked at where I actually fit, and where I didn't yet.
Every application tailored. My words. Nothing sent without me.
I practiced. Tracked everything. Followed up.
The gap's still on my résumé. It's just not the headline anymore.
